Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NEERI Project Assistant-II?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 07 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. degree in Chemistry, Environmental Science, Botany, or Zoology from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this CSIR NEERI recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Assistant-II post.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the CSIR NEERI office in Hyderabad, Telangana (Pincode: 500007).

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant certificates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in-Interview.
